messages:
Nina (AE): ACME POC failing with 413 on /v1/generate. They POST a single JSON with ~4MB of docs. Demo tomorrow, need quick unblock.

ACME-Dev: curl: (22) 413 Request Entity Too Large. Content-Length: 3984120. We go through corp-nginx -> our edge. No compression.

Omar (SE): Likely proxy limit (corp or our edge). Quick workaround: gzip the request body and set Content-Encoding: gzip. We accept gzipped bodies.

Lee (Infra): If they need us to, we can temporarily increase max_body_size on their dedicated trial. Send instance id and target size. This is for short windows only.

Evan (SalesEng): They want to avoid pre-indexing. Warn that single-shot for 120 docs is fragile and costs a lot. Suggest gzip + small bump for demo, but plan for embeddings for production.

ACME-Dev: Instance ded-21b4. Can you raise to 10MB for 6 hours?

Lee (Infra): Filing request. deploy-bot: CRE-9011 opened to bump max_body_size to 10M on ded-21b4 for 6h. Pending edge approval.

Omar (SE): Short dev tips: 1) gzip payload:
curl -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" --data-binary @req.gz https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
2) Or split docs into batches ~150-200KB and send multiple small requests, then merge results.

ACME-Dev: We tried gzip and got 200 but output seemed incompleteis the model truncating input?

Omar (SE): Two limits: transport size (we just addressed) and model context window. The model truncates input beyond its context capacity (8k/32k etc.). max_tokens only caps response size. For large corpora use embeddings + retrieval or pick a model with larger context.

deploy-bot: CRE-9011 approved and applied to ded-21b4 :04UTC 9-Mar-2026.

ACME-Dev: Re-ran with gzip -> success. Demo good.

Evan (SalesEng): Action items: I'll send a short note comparing one-shot cost vs embeddings. Omar to share gzip + batching snippets. Lee to schedule rollback in 6h.

Nina (AE): Thanks all, marking POC blocker cleared. :thumbsup:
